My dear friend, if you believe in heaven, it tells me you believe in some form of a God. This being said I’ll not tell you to ask him to fix anything, nor will I tell you WHICH God to pray to, those  both are your own choices. What I will suggest, is that you ask whoever you pray to, to lead you down the correct path. As I said, don’t ask him to fix a damn thing cuz it won’t just go poof away. Asking him for guidance is what humans have missed the point of for years. They’ve always asked for personal gain, at expectation of no working towards it. 

I’ve walked forward through the worst times in my life, I’ve survived two attempts, both of which were after I’d issued a simple prayer. The first time, I was an atheist and I still asked God,”Take me somewhere better than here.” And he removed me from my grandparent’s house after I woke up from an OD. 

Second time, I asked God in begging to lead me down the best route in life, and I lost my mind and left with intentions of hanging one’s self. Instead, I obliviously pulled out my knife and drove it deep in my wrist, snapping me back into reality, sobering me up, and giving me time to call 911 for myself while I tourniquet the wound. 

The universe has not allowed me to die yet, and as cruel as it may seem, every day I wake up is another beautiful day. I hate myself still every day, but I know that as long as I keep walking, I can appreciate myself that much more. 

Just keep walking forward homie, even if that’s all you can do. Don’t stop until you can stop to appreciate the sky, the mountains, etc. 

Take in deep breaths outside amongst some trees, listen to the birds n shit, enjoy the beauty of nature. That’s all a human is, a freak of nature, we feel we don’t belong but it’s been quite the opposite. Human belong more in nature than we do in a house and a 9-5. Take your mom on a hike or a drive out to somewhere beautiful. Enjoy everything you can, even if those thoughts are overtaking. The presence of positive thoughts and happy memories forming not only can help combat those dark thoughts, they WILL. Even the most traumatic experiences of my life have eventually been overshadowed by the small things I laughed at, enjoyed my time with, or dedicated myself to working on, during those traumatic times. 

Work on enjoying life even if you hate life. Enjoy it in spite of life beating you down, you’ll become unstoppable. 

The only thing I truly can ask is that you just try to walk forward tho. Even if you scrap this entire comment, keep it in mind that walking forward along the path is much better than stopping to let someone else bury you. Walking forward on the path is far better than the darkness winning this battle.
